post.summary: Invite a user to organization (ADMIN/MODERATOR only)

delete.summary: Remove a member from an organization (ADMIN/MODERATOR only)
delete.description: Removes a member from an organization. Only organization ADMIN or MODERATOR members are allowed to remove other members. The removed user will receive a notification.

400.description: userId or organizationId is missing or invalid

403.description: User does not have permission to remove members

post.summary: Create a join request or organization invitation
post.description: Creates a new pending join request. Depending on the direction, this endpoint either allows a user to request joining an organization or allows an organization to invite a user.

400.description: Join request already exists or request body is invalid

patch.description: Updates the status of a pending join request. Depending on the request direction, only organization staff (ADMIN or MODERATOR) or the invited user may perform this action.

400.description: Join request already processed or invalid request

403.description: User does not have permission to update this request

get.summary: Get pending join requests for an organization
get.description: Returns all pending join requests for the specified organization. Accessible only to organization ADMIN and MODERATOR members.

403.description: User is not allowed to view organization join requests

get.description: Returns a pending join request. Accessible to the request sender or organization staff.

400.description: Join request already processed or invalid ID

403.description: User does not have permission to view this request
